run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if two strings are anagrams of each other
test_f_gold: test f_gold with pairs of strings to verify anagram detection correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a character frequency counter instead of sorting
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty strings or unicode characters
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns 1 if two strings are anagrams and 0 otherwise
